title: Cover extraction: R2 path uploads with key='pending', never renamed to result_hash
description: On VPS with LIVECHORD_USE_R2=1, _extract_cover(audio_path, 'pending') uploads to R2 with key 'pending'. The follow-up 'pending.jpg → {result_hash}.jpg' rename only handles local disk (Path.rename). R2 path leaves the cover at key 'pending' and /api/process/cover/<result_hash> returns 404. Affects every cover-having upload on https://livechord.org. Fix: extract bytes synchronously, upload after result_hash known.
close_reason: Deployed via 6464835. Cover: refactored _extract_cover into _read_cover_bytes (pure read) + _persist_cover (writes after result_hash known) so R2 path no longer strands covers under key 'pending'. Existing R2 covers under 'pending' are unrecoverable but new uploads write to the correct key. Auto-split: added halved-downbeats fallback in chord_splitter — when raw bpb ∈ [1.7, 2.3] and 2*bpb ∈ [3,5], use every other downbeat. Air Supply 'Out Of Nothing At All' (hash e3ee0776cdb0) now splits 89 → 118 chords with reason 'ok-halved-downbeats'; player shows bar-sized cards (G 0:00, G 0:03, Em7 0:07, Em7 0:10) instead of the previous 7-second mega-cards. 25/25 chord_splitter tests pass.

# Phase B Handover — OAuth Console Credentials Acquired (2026-05-02)

## ⚠ Phase A status (do NOT redo) — commits 09c6882 + b9653ef

Phase A (LiveChord-itk) is **closed**. The following are already in the codebase:

- `config.is_public_mode()` / `is_personal_mode()` (alongside existing `is_beta_mode()`); `LIVECHORD_MODE=public` recognised end-to-end
- `auth_api.get_optional_user(request, authorization)` at L264 — returns username or None, never raises
- `auth_api.get_user_or_anon(request, authorization, x_anon_id)` at L301 — returns username or `anon_<id>`, raises 400 if anon header malformed
- `auth_api.is_anon(username)` at L324 — `anon_` prefix check
- `auth_api._ANON_ID_RE` / `_ANON_PREFIX` constants
- LAN bypass in `get_current_user` (L225) / `get_admin_user` (L330) is `is_personal_mode()`-only — public mode has NO LAN bypass
- `personal_mode.require_personal_mode` rejects 404 on **any** non-personal mode (was beta-only)
- `process_api._require_user_facing` (renamed from `_require_beta`, alias kept) — broadened to `is_beta_mode() or is_public_mode()`
- 8 `process_api` endpoints flipped from `get_current_user` to `get_user_or_anon` (upload / youtube / status / result / yt-library-learn / playlist-info / youtube-search / upgrade-beats-status). `/my-history` kept on `get_current_user`.
- `feedback_api._require_user_facing` same rename + broadening; ratings/bug still mandatory login
- `auto_worker._public_mode_overrides()` flips `bar_arbitrator_enabled` + `beat_refiner_enabled` to True in public mode (default-on auto-bar-split)
- New `frontend/js/auth.js` (~150 lines) — shared fetch wrapper:
  - mints/persists `localStorage.livechord_anon_id`
  - injects `Authorization: Bearer <token>` if logged in, else `X-Anon-Id: <id>`
  - 401 in public mode returns the response (caller handles); beta/personal evicts token + bounces /login
  - exposes `window.LiveChordAuth.{getAnonId, isAnonymous, getMode, refreshMode}`
  - **OAuth callback URLs are exempt from the 401 redirect** (line 96-99): the regex skips `/api/auth/oauth/*` so the OAuth start/callback flow can return 401/302 without surprising bounces.
- `index.html`, `player.html`, `tos.html` updated to use the shared wrapper. **Other pages still have inline duplicates** — admin.html / editor.html / process.html / extraction.html / benchmark.html / login.html still hold their own fetch wrapper. For Phase B's `login.html` rewrite, replace the inline wrapper with the shared `auth.js` for consistency.
- `.env.example` checked in (commit b9653ef) with all required env vars enumerated

value: R2 cover bug pattern: any code path that writes data to R2/S3 under a placeholder key with intent to 'rename later' is broken — object stores have no rename, only put. Pattern: extract bytes synchronously (pure read), persist AFTER the canonical key is known. Bit us once with _extract_cover('pending') in process_queue; fixed by splitting into _read_cover_bytes + _persist_cover and reordering the call sites.

yt-removal stage 3 (cb584b8) deleted PianoSynth class but left ~14 dangling aiSynth.* references in player.js — applyAudioMode() threw ReferenceError during init, halting post-registry _switchTab retry → guitar/uke/accordion/arranger tabs stuck at display:none. Fixed 2026-05-04 via inert aiSynth stub. Audio mode UI (Music/MIDI/Mix) cycles 3 states but MIDI/Mix produce silence. Cleanup of the dead audio-mode UI is a follow-up.

Cache-bust discipline reminder: bumping CSS file content is not enough — also bump the ?v= query string in EVERY HTML file referencing it. Bit us once with player.css edit deploying but accordion overlap appearing unfixed in QA because v=115 was still in player.html. Same applies to JS. Lesson: when editing a CSS or JS file, immediately bump every ?v= reference to it via 'grep -l <filename>?v= frontend/*.html | xargs sed -i'.
